purpose: CP128 documentation-only baseline freeze after native-accepted CP127. Numerical characteristics are identical to v0.4; stale STL/Missile-delivery explanatory notes are reconciled and the accepted pure-TL stabilization status is explicit before broader TL sensitivity.
principles: Operational STL standard Move equals installed STL Drive TL; technology fiction may progress unevenly through Space, overload, reliability, fuel, or specialist branches rather than silently changing this base movement invariant.
Operational Missile Move equals installed Missile Drive TL plus 1; range/endurance, guidance, payload, and PDS interaction remain separate progression axes.
Strategic FTL movement may progress unevenly. The current 1,2,3,4,4,6,7,9,12 ladder is an explicit strategic exception retained from the post-CP109 maturation model, not a combat movement rule.
Technology progress may be uneven: introduction, maturation, integration and peak-performance steps are valid where supported by technology fiction and testing.
The canonical x2 point-domain ruler permits odd values but does not require a +1 step every TL.
Weapon families remain asymmetric. Kinetic trends Armor-facing, Energy trends Shield-facing, and Missile remains the flexible delivery/payload family.
Missile delivery, guidance/seeker, GP warhead yield and Swarmer Flight characteristics are separate authorities.
Quiet TLs and specialist branches are valid; do not invent filler improvements.
Damage Control starts at one canonical Hull per successful Repair Kit and improves only as explicit Hull/DamCon technology.
Critical/H-X cadence remains deferred until fully implemented.
The native-accepted CP127 pure-TL stabilization establishes the working main-subsystem TL1-TL9 baseline for broader TL-sensitivity work; most AUX progression remains explicitly deferred.

hardPrerequisites.rationale: The propulsion concept explicitly relies on practical Fusion; Propulsion still gains its TL3 FTL/navigation advance even if the STL item remains latent.
Antimatter catalysis requires practical antimatter production/containment; the Propulsion TL5 FTL advance remains ungated.
Uses the same antimatter enabling science while maturing the propulsion application.
Onboard correction, course prediction and bounded Approximate-track fire require contemporary photonic/optical guidance computation.
The branch depends on compact high-rate pulsed power rather than passive material strength alone.
Adaptive threat classification/control is the enabling cross-pollination; the earlier powered branch already carries its power burden.
This branch explicitly reuses mature defensive-field control rather than making passive Armor itself field-dependent.
A sustained charged-particle weapon needs the high-output power/conditioning frontier represented by mature high-output Fusion.
The specialist screen depends on mature understanding of charged-particle beam behavior.
Fast distributed field control is the enabling technology; the base TL7 Shield remains independently researchable.
Practical controlled Fusion knowledge enables a compact fusion microcharge; unlock is automatic when both requirements exist.
The drive explicitly consumes antimatter technology; Missile TL7 still provides native anti-emitter seeker and AMM advances if this delivery upgrade remains latent.
Antimatter production/containment is a genuine enabling science, not a generic breadth bonus.
The optional branch adapts inertial/field propulsion science to terminal maneuvering; the TL8 exotic seeker remains native Missile progression.
Autonomous inspection/manipulation requires the mature automation foundation but does not gate core Hull progression.
Distributed autonomous agents are the causal enabling technology; the Hull TL6 structural lattice remains independent.
